headline: CDMO engine firing, Cenexi still the swing factor

highlights: Business performance: Gland reported revenue of Rs18.3bn in Q2 FY27, up 23.3% YoY, driven by strong CDMO growth and steady demand in critical injectables, with new US launches and volume gains in existing products.
ROW and India were weak due to tender delays and low volume uptake.
EBITDA rose 54.2% YoY to Rs4.8bn, with margin up 529bps to 26.4%, on a better business mix, operating leverage and lower other expenses, even after R&D spend rose 75.4% YoY.
Cenexi reported an EBITDA loss of €6mn on its planned annual shutdown, which also kept the tax rate high at 32.5%.
valuation: Valuation: We roll forward our valuation to Sep-28E and raise our target multiple to 34x from 25x, arriving at a revised TP of ₹3,553 (from ₹2,885).
Our revised multiple sits about 0.2 standard deviations below Gland’s five-year mean forward P/E of 37x, compared with roughly 0.9 standard deviations below for our earlier 25x.
We stop short of the historical average because part of the five-year mean was set during the FY24-25 earnings trough, when depressed EPS inflated the multiple.
watch: Outlook: We forecast net sales growing at a 13% CAGR over FY26-29E and EBITDA growing at a 16% CAGR over FY27-29E.
Demand in key emerging markets remains healthy.  The management expects ROW to improve.
